Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Aditi - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Hema - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Anil - 37 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Aditi, Hema and Anil stand near him.]

Aditi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya puts on his school uniform.]

Hema: "Really?"

[Aditya combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Hema: "Show me too!"

[Aditya puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Aditya: "Oh wow!"

[Aditi applies kajal to her eyes.]

Anil: "Exactly right."

[Aditi puts on red lipstick.]

Aditi: "Really?"

[Aditi puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Aditi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
